user.title: Connect to Stirling PDF
user.description: Enter the full local URL of your Stirling PDF instance.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Stirling PDF
reconfigure.description: Change the server URL or API key.

reauth_confirm.title: Update authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The Stirling PDF server rejected the configured API key. Enter a valid key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the URL and whether Stirling PDF is running.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Stirling PDF instance can be configured.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Stirling PDF configuration is not loaded.

path_not_allowed.message: The path `{path}` is not allowed by Home Assistant. Add its parent directory to `allowlist_external_dirs`.

invalid_extension.message: The path `{path}` must use the `{extension}` extension.

invalid_languages.message: Enter at least one valid OCR language code, such as `eng` or `deu`.

output_exists.message: The output file `{path}` already exists. Enable overwrite or choose another path.

authentication_failed.message: Stirling PDF rejected the API key.

processing_failed.message: Stirling PDF could not process the document: {error}

file_error.message: Home Assistant could not read or write the file: {error}

merge.name: Merge PDFs

file_paths.description: Absolute paths of the PDF files to merge, in order.

output_path.name: Output path
output_path.description: Absolute path for the merged PDF.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

split.name: Split PDF

page_numbers.description: Split points such as `2,5`, ranges, `all`, or functions such as `2n+1`.

output_path.description: Absolute `.zip` path for the resulting PDFs.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.
